title: Joshua 11: The Northern Kings Utterly Destroyed
body:
Read the chapter → [Joshua 11](/bible/joshua/11)

**[Joshua 11:1-5](/bible/joshua/11#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/joshua/11#v1)</sup> And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/joshua/11#v2)</sup> And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/joshua/11#v3)</sup> And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/joshua/11#v4)</sup> And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/joshua/11#v5)</sup> And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

- When Jabin king of Hazor heard those things, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph, and to the kings of the north, to the Canaanite, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Hivite under Hermon.
- They went out, they and all their hosts, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many. Their plan was to come against Israel in force and overcome them with sheer numbers, and they pitched together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

**[Joshua 11:6-9](/bible/joshua/11#v6)**

> <sup>[6](/bible/joshua/11#v6)</sup> And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/joshua/11#v7)</sup> So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/joshua/11#v8)</sup> And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth–maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/joshua/11#v9)</sup> And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

- The LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
- Joshua came against them by the waters of Merom suddenly, and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them and chased them unto great Zidon and unto Misrephoth-maim, until they left them none remaining. Houghing the horses goes into binding up the horses' legs so they were finished as instruments of war.
- Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses and burnt their chariots with fire.

**[Joshua 11:10-15](/bible/joshua/11#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/joshua/11#v10)</sup> And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/joshua/11#v11)</sup> And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/joshua/11#v12)</sup> And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/joshua/11#v13)</sup> But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/joshua/11#v14)</sup> And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/joshua/11#v15)</sup> As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

- Joshua turned back and took Hazor, for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms, and smote all the souls therein with the edge of the sword; there was not any left to breathe, and he burnt Hazor with fire. But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only.
- All the spoil of these cities and the cattle the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves, but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, neither left they any to breathe. As the LORD commanded Moses, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua: he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
- There is a law pertaining to war: when thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, proclaim peace unto it, and if it answers peace the people become tributaries and serve thee. But that applied to cities very far off. Of the cities of these people, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth, but shalt utterly destroy them.
- The Most High is not unjust in what he does. It was already prophesied to Abram that his seed would be afflicted four hundred years and in the fourth generation come hither again, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full. When Israel came back to establish the land, it was time for those nations to pay for their iniquities from way back when.
- [Genesis 15:13](/bible/genesis/15#v13) is not talking about America. Judah has been here longer than four hundred years and the northern kingdom longer than six hundred, so this is not us coming up out of Babylon the great; and Israel was actually in Egypt four hundred and thirty years, free for the first thirty.

  Precepts:
  - **[Deuteronomy 20:10-17](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v10)**
    > <sup>[10](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v10)</sup> When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.
    >
    > <sup>[11](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v11)</sup> And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.
    >
    > <sup>[12](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v12)</sup> And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:
    >
    > <sup>[13](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v13)</sup> And when the Lord thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v14)</sup> But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, even all the spoil thereof, shalt thou take unto thyself; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies, which the Lord thy God hath given thee.
    >
    > <sup>[15](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v15)</sup> Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee, which are not of the cities of these nations.
    >
    > <sup>[16](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v16)</sup> But of the cities of these people, which the Lord thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:
    >
    > <sup>[17](/bible/deuteronomy/20#v17)</sup> But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee:

    The law of war: far-off cities that answer peace become tributaries, but of the cities of these nations save alive nothing that breatheth.
  - **[Genesis 15:13-16](/bible/genesis/15#v13)**
    > <sup>[13](/bible/genesis/15#v13)</sup> And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/genesis/15#v14)</sup> And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
    >
    > <sup>[15](/bible/genesis/15#v15)</sup> And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
    >
    > <sup>[16](/bible/genesis/15#v16)</sup> But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

    Thy seed shall serve and be afflicted four hundred years and come hither again in the fourth generation, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full; the destruction was prophesied and just.

**[Joshua 11:16-20](/bible/joshua/11#v16)**

> <sup>[16](/bible/joshua/11#v16)</sup> So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/joshua/11#v17)</sup> Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/joshua/11#v18)</sup> Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/joshua/11#v19)</sup> There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/joshua/11#v20)</sup> For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

- So Joshua took all that land, the hills, all the south country, all the land of Goshen, the valley, the plain, and the mountain of Israel; all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them. Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
- There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon; that is why all of them went into destruction. It was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour.
- There is nothing new under the sun; it shall happen again, and we are just waiting on it to unfold. The nation and kingdom that will not serve Israel shall perish, and those nations shall be utterly wasted; the sons of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee.
- We see the Most High setting it up right before our eyes: Israel is being made into warriors once again, so the days of Joshua can be once again when the Lord returns. He is setting us in order before our enemies' eyes.
- Esau thinks the Most High is altogether such a one as himself, that the Most High looks like him and is happy with him punishing and oppressing us. He is not down for it; it is our punishment and it has to happen, but he will reprove Esau and set Israel in order before his eyes.
- When Christ returns he will destroy all nations in the valley of Megiddo, and after Israel's spirits are changed he will thrust out the enemy from before us and say, Destroy them. Israel will lay the vengeance of the Most High upon Edom according to his anger and according to his fury. Brothers, you just have to endure to the end; this is how you read the Bible, precept upon precept, here a little and there a little.

  Precepts:
  - **[Isaiah 60:12-15](/bible/isaiah/60#v12)**
    > <sup>[12](/bible/isaiah/60#v12)</sup> For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
    >
    > <sup>[13](/bible/isaiah/60#v13)</sup> The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/isaiah/60#v14)</sup> The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
    >
    > <sup>[15](/bible/isaiah/60#v15)</sup> Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

    The nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; the sons of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; it shall happen again.
  - **[Joel 2:7-11](/bible/joel/2#v7)**
    > <sup>[7](/bible/joel/2#v7)</sup> They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
    >
    > <sup>[8](/bible/joel/2#v8)</sup> Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
    >
    > <sup>[9](/bible/joel/2#v9)</sup> They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
    >
    > <sup>[10](/bible/joel/2#v10)</sup> The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
    >
    > <sup>[11](/bible/joel/2#v11)</sup> And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

    They shall run like mighty men and climb the wall like men of war; the LORD shall utter his voice before his army; Israel made into warriors once again.
  - **[Psalms 50:21](/bible/psalms/50#v21)**
    > <sup>[21](/bible/psalms/50#v21)</sup> These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

    Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself; but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
  - **[Deuteronomy 33:27](/bible/deuteronomy/33#v27)**
    > <sup>[27](/bible/deuteronomy/33#v27)</sup> The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

    He shall thrust out the enemy from before thee, and shall say, Destroy them.
  - **[Ezekiel 25:12-14](/bible/ezekiel/25#v12)**
    > <sup>[12](/bible/ezekiel/25#v12)</sup> Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
    >
    > <sup>[13](/bible/ezekiel/25#v13)</sup> Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
    >
    > <sup>[14](/bible/ezekiel/25#v14)</sup> And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.

    Edom revenged himself upon Judah over and above his charge; I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel.
  - **[Micah 5:15](/bible/micah/5#v15)**
    > <sup>[15](/bible/micah/5#v15)</sup> And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

    I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

**[Joshua 11:21-23](/bible/joshua/11#v21)**

> <sup>[21](/bible/joshua/11#v21)</sup> And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/joshua/11#v22)</sup> There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/joshua/11#v23)</sup> So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

- At that time came Joshua and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah and Israel; Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities. None of the Anakims were left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod there remained.
- So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses, and gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
